disposition: retain as an appendix-level common-compound performance reserve; no nominee change
route: short-term exercise-performance compensation; no BUBR1 restoration hypothesis established

screening_provenance.screening_scope: single-reader title/metadata/abstract eligibility screen; whole batch remains pending independent lane review

study.design: 20 resistance-trained adults; four seven-day crossover conditions; no-capsule control fixed first, followed by randomized placebo, low-dose and high-dose capsule conditions

interventions.placebo: capsule placebo; details not independently recovered

reported_results.bench_press_1rm_vs_control: low dose +3.33 kg (ES 0.72, P=.005); high dose +2.34 kg (ES 0.49, P=.041); article also reports both extract conditions exceeding placebo
reported_results.leg_press_1rm: placebo and both extract conditions exceeded no-capsule control; reported low-dose contrast +37.2 kg (ES 1.33, P<.001) and high-dose contrast +25.8 kg (ES 1.11, P<.001)
reported_results.leg_press_volume_vs_control: low dose +2627 kg (ES 1.56, P<.001); high dose +1025 kg (ES 0.74, P=.004); article reports low dose also exceeded placebo
reported_results.tendo_bench_power_vs_placebo: high dose peak +79.5 W (P=.006) and mean +46.2 W (P=.026)
reported_results.placebo_control_pattern: Placebo improved leg-press 1RM and volume relative to the fixed first no-capsule period; article discusses expectancy, learning, repeated testing and period effects
reported_results.safety: authors report no treatment-related concerns in the short trial; adverse-event detail was not independently verified

limitations: 20 resistance-trained adults and seven days per condition; no durable or clinical function outcome
No-capsule control was always first, so no-capsule contrasts may include order or familiarization effects
Broad outcome battery; outcome hierarchy and multiplicity strategy were not verified
No BUB1B/BUBR1, chromosome-fidelity or MVA measurement
Exact tested extract is not equivalent by default to blackcurrant food, juice, seed oil, anthocyanin isolates or retail products
Direct publisher-page fetch returned HTTP 429; complete full-text review is not claimed

competitiveness.versus_niacin: Acute controlled exercise-performance signal, but no NAD/SIRT2/BUBR1 rationale or disease-specific evidence; endpoints are not comparable
competitiveness.versus_apitegromab: No pediatric neuromuscular-disease motor-function evidence; not comparable to SMA trial outcomes
competitiveness.decision: Appendix-level performance benchmark only; not a Track 2 lead or nominee replacement
